purpose: Describe failure timing and continuation of the rejected confirmation-zone model; no new strategy, threshold search, or counterfactual profits.

diagnostic_rules.elapsed_bars_basis: From filled-bar OPEN to recorded outcome-bar CLOSE, inclusive; <=1h, (1h,4h], (4h,24h], >24h. Excludes unfilled and censored outcomes.
diagnostic_rules.preterminal_path: Only contiguous closed candles strictly after the unknown intrabar fill candle and strictly before the recorded terminal candle. OPEN includes the full contiguous closed prefix to period end. DATA_GAP stops before the missing candle.
diagnostic_rules.roll_failure: First strictly adverse candle close versus frozen roll level in the preterminal prefix. An exact-level close is separately recorded. Neither the fill nor terminal candle may establish this observation.
diagnostic_rules.r_basis: Favorable/adverse price distance divided by absolute assumed entry minus frozen stop; not cost-adjusted net-risk R.
diagnostic_rules.cost_share: (net stop risk - nominal entry-to-stop price distance) / net stop risk; includes both adverse slippages and fees. Not a profitability adjustment or tuning rule.
diagnostic_rules.features: Reconstruct first signal using only closed 180-bar 4H/15M windows. Record setup age from breakout CLOSE, signal stop distance in ATR4/ATR15, confirmation roll margin, body, trend spread. No outcome-dependent input.
diagnostic_rules.verification: Rebuild the whole original confirmation-zone report from SHA-verified market sources and unchanged controls; exact original ledger, prices, outcomes, metrics and portfolios required.
diagnostic_rules.denominators: Show all statuses and OPEN censoring. SL latency has SL denominator; preterminal low-MFE is a lower-bound observation, not proof that the terminal candle never rallied before SL. All status groups retained, no best-performing subgroup selection.

decision: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY_NO_RULE_CHANGE. Any next strategy must be separately registered and evaluated on unused future periods; rejected model stays KILL and its forward collection remains disabled.
